    • decodeConfigArrayToDoubleValues

      public static List<Double> decodeConfigArrayToDoubleValues(String[] parameterArray, List<Parameter<?>> flattenedParameters)
      Converts a decoded configuration array (e.g. from DerivationTreeSolution.toParameterArray()) to a numeric vector in the same format produced by decodeParameterToDoubleValues(org.uma.evolver.parameter.Parameter<?>, double).

      For each parameter in flattenedParameters:

      • If the parameter is present in parameterArray: its decoded string value is mapped to a double (index for categoricals, actual value for numerics).
      • If absent (inactive parameter): Double.NaN is written.
      Parameters:
      parameterArray - the --name value pairs from a decoded tree solution
      flattenedParameters - the complete flattened parameter list from the parameter space
      Returns:
      a list of doubles of the same length as flattenedParameters

    • getActiveParameterIndices

      public static Set<Integer> getActiveParameterIndices(List<Parameter<?>> topLevelParameters, List<Parameter<?>> flattenedParameters, List<Double> values)
      Given a flattened list of parameters and their encoded values, determines which parameters are "active" (i.e., their parent categorical parameter's value activates them).
      Parameters:
      topLevelParameters - The top-level parameters from the parameter space
      flattenedParameters - The flattened list of all parameters
      values - The encoded values [0.0, 1.0] for each flattened parameter
      Returns:
      A set of parameter indices that are active
